value.rationale: Ball slabs are natural elementary convex solids, and random orthographic perimeter/mean support is a standard intrinsic-volume observable. A nonball giving exactly circular shadows with strictly positive probability, an adjacent fractional contact onset in all dimensions, a dimension-three logarithmic lower endpoint, and two-parameter reconstruction together reveal distinctive geometry with potential use in inverse shape analysis. The result is not a routine known-volume conversion or an arbitrary parameter slice; it characterizes the full distribution and its singularities.
